notes: Fix: the ▶ Preview (play) button on the scene preview did nothing on Safari/iOS — no sound. The scene's voice/SFX/BGM audio was created and play()'d AFTER awaits (settings load, voice-URL fetch), so it was outside the click's user-gesture and Safari silently blocked it (the error was swallowed). Now the audio elements are created and primed (a tiny silent clip) synchronously inside the click gesture, then their real source is set and played — so playback is allowed. Verified no regression in Chromium (voiceover still plays). Note: the background video always autoplays muted on loop; ▶ plays the scene's voiceover + re-runs the text animations.
